name: @afa/application
description: Application layer. Use-case orchestration, application services, and DTOs. Depends only on @afa/domain (entities/interfaces) — never on @afa/infrastructure directly; the composition root in each apps/* bootstrap binds domain interfaces to infrastructure implementations via NestJS DI tokens. Business modules are implemented in a later phase (ENGINEERING-TASK-BREAKDOWN.md Phase 4 onward) — this package is currently structural scaffolding only.
